limits: Only listed originals are retained. Scratch absolute paths and original Markdown links remain historical provenance and are not rewritten; this source map translates retained originals/aliases/derivatives.
Repeated graph/list outputs and large input maps have full fingerprints only or named-field parsed excerpts; the archive does not claim to preserve or rerun the entire dependency closure.

Original excerpts inside independent failure analysis remain that author's derived excerpts, even when their excerpt-file bytes are archived unchanged; they do not substitute for the retained complete failure raw.
No material request body, secret material/hash, session cookie, CSRF token, database secret, private runtime tree or buffer-level trace was copied.
All raw formatting exceptions preserve original bytes and hashes; no ignore rules or normalization. These are byte-scanner findings, not a claimed git diff --check result.
